- 20m: technical deep-dive (SE) + ops/observability highlights

1) Thu Jul 15, 10:00–10:45
2) Fri Jul 16, 14:00–14:45
3) Mon Jul 19, 11:00–11:45

Thanks — looking forward to locking in a time.

—
Monica Patel
